interpretation.es: La voz narrativa intenta olvidar un amor buscando cariño en otras personas. La imagen del picaflor que va de flor en flor sugiere coqueteo o amores pasajeros, pero los recuerdos regresan. En una parte posterior se evoca el impacto del primer amor y la emoción de enamorarse.
interpretation.enUS: The narrator seeks new affection to forget a past love, moving from person to person like a hummingbird from flower to flower. The memories keep returning, and later lines recall the powerful feelings of falling in love for the first time.
interpretation.enUK: The narrator looks for affection elsewhere to forget a former love, flitting between romantic interests like a hummingbird visiting flowers. The memories keep coming back, alongside recollections of the force of first love.
interpretation.confidence: interpretation from visible song captions; literary analysis, not a quoted artist explanation
